environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.11) running as part of a Step Functions workflow for document processing. The Lambda execution role has s3:PutObject permission on the processing bucket with Resource 'arn:aws:s3:::doc-processing-prod/*' (wildcard on all keys). No IAM permission boundary attached. No SCP applied to the account. The PROCESSING_BUCKET is 'doc-processing-prod' and EXTRACT_PREFIX is 'extracted/'. The same S3 bucket also stores Lambda deployment packages under 'deployments/' prefix and CloudFormation templates under 'cfn-templates/' prefix.
